query:
SELECT COALESCE (
            (
                SELECT COUNT(appid) OVER () as count
                FROM user_game
                INNER JOIN steam_game USING(appid)
                WHERE (appid = $1 OR $2)
                AND (LOWER(email) = ANY($3) OR $4)
                AND ($5::text IS NULL OR name ILIKE $5)
                GROUP BY
                    appid,
                    name
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            0
        );
